externalWalls.title: A running value anchored at the first bar (an all-time ratchet, an all-time high, an anchored VWAP reaching past the look-back cap)
externalWalls.census: host `budget:lookback` (cap 960 bars, ruled not raised 2026-11-17); the runtime lane runs from the first bar the chart hands it, so it is a wall there only when that bar is not TradingView's
externalWalls.witness: measured 2026-11-18 by another session (local): SPY 1D from the 1993 listing, a level rising since the listing is 82% bar-equal to a windowed value at W=900 and 20% off at worst; McGinley 14 (a decaying recurrence) is bit-equal at W=300. A decaying recurrence converges inside a window; a running extreme or sum does not, at any W the cap allows

externalWalls.title: A DAILY read on an intraday chart (previous day's high / low / close, daily pivots): a request.security to a higher timeframe
externalWalls.census: host `tf` reads weekly and monthly only (`pine:request`: "another timeframe as `tf` (weekly and monthly ...)"); the session-reader spelling exceeds `budget:lookback` (1361 vs 960). On the 1D census a "D" request is the chart's own timeframe, so it never shows
externalWalls.witness: measured 2026-11-18 by the Create Indicator capability census (local REPORT.md): 2 of 177 ideas (previous day H/L/C, daily pivots) blocked by exactly this

externalWalls.title: U-CONFIRM: when TradingView confirms a closed daily bar for a strategy. A default strategy (calc_on_every_tick false) runs a bar once TradingView confirms it, and a capture taken after the session close can still hold a newest bar its strategy has not run
externalWalls.census: the census runs every script on closed bars it treats as confirmed; the grade cuts only an ABSENT newest value row of a strategy capture (an `na` row, or a row missing anywhere else, is compared)
externalWalls.witness: r1-strategy-draws-rddt-1d-2026-10-02: 636 bars and 635 value rows, bar 635's session closed at 20:00Z and the capture was taken at 22:57Z (newestBarIsForming false); its indicator twin (no broker) holds all 636. The 2026-11-16 report captures (22:09-23:18Z) hold the same shape. Pinned by one strategy captured just before and just after TradingView confirms the bar
